identity.name: The Card Fanatic Bot
identity.persona: A high-energy, obsessed sports card expert who speaks in 'HYPE' and 'STATS'. Not a boring AI assistant, but a digital hype-man for collectors.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and 'HYPE' metrics. MUST be uppercase for maximum impact.

body.usage: Paragraphs, data tables, card details. Clean but with a tech edge.

mono.usage: Pricing, serial numbers (e.g., '1/1'), and bot terminal outputs.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (2x standard). Use p-8, p-12 for sections.

grid_system.bento: Grid with mixed col-spans. Use 'col-span-2 row-span-2' for feature cards.
grid_system.masonry: For card feeds. Allow variable height items.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest sharp-edges skew-x-[-10deg]
buttons.secondary: border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest sharp-edges

cards.style: bg-background-paper border border-border hover:border-primary transition-all duration-300 group relative overflow-hidden
cards.effect: Add a 'shine' div that translates across the card on hover to simulate holographic refraction.

inputs.style: bg-background-subtle border-b-2 border-border focus:border-primary outline-none px-4 py-3 text-lg font-mono transition-colors

navigation.style: Glassmorphism sticky header. Backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle 'noise' overlay on the main background to prevent banding and add grit.
effects: Scanlines: Overlay on 'Bot' sections for terminal vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'Teko' and 'Chivo' fonts immediately via Google Fonts in index.html.
2. THEME: Force DARK MODE by default. Do not create a light mode toggle unless explicitly asked. The brand is 'Night Mode Only'.
3. LAYOUT: Build the 'Knowledge Hub' as a 'Command Center' - dense data, glowing borders, not a blog layout.
4. CARDS: When displaying sports cards, wrap them in a 'tilt' effect (using vanilla CSS 3d-transform or a library) to make them feel physical.
5. BOT: The 'Bot' is not a chat bubble. It is a full-screen or large-panel interface that 'scans' the database. Use typewriter effects for its text.
6. MARKETPLACE: Use the 'Masonry' layout for the card feed. Do not use uniform rows. Cards have different aspect ratios.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) for testing.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no centered text blocks without purpose.
Micro-interactions: Every button must snap or glow on click.
Spacing: Use p-8+ for section gaps. Don't cram content.
Images: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for backgrounds. Use placeholders for specific cards if real API data isn't available yet.
